annexure: Annexure A - Statutory Curriculum Outcomes & Taxonomy Standard

programOutcomes.title: Engineering Knowledge
programOutcomes.statement: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural sciences, computing, and engineering fundamentals to the solution of complex computer engineering problems.

programOutcomes.title: Problem Analysis
programOutcomes.statement: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics and engineering sciences.

programOutcomes.title: Design & Development of Solutions
programOutcomes.statement: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet specified needs with consideration for public health, safety, societal, and environmental factors.

programOutcomes.title: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems
programOutcomes.statement: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of information to provide valid conclusions.

programOutcomes.title: Modern Tool Usage
programOutcomes.statement: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of limitations.

programOutcomes.title: The Engineer and Society
programOutcomes.statement: Apply reasoning informed by contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to professional engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Environment and Sustainability
programOutcomes.statement: Understand the impact of professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.

programOutcomes.title: Ethics
programOutcomes.statement: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Individual and Team Work
programOutcomes.statement: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

programOutcomes.title: Communication
programOutcomes.statement: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, including comprehending and writing effective reports and documentation.

programOutcomes.title: Project Management and Finance
programOutcomes.statement: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering and management principles and apply these to manage projects in multidisciplinary environments.

programOutcomes.title: Life-long Learning
programOutcomes.statement: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: System Architecture & Software Engineering
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Architect, construct, and verify secure, resilient software applications and distributed systems conforming to industry architectural standards.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Algorithmic Precision & Cyber-Infrastructure
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Deploy algorithmic optimizations, cryptographic mechanisms, and cyber-infrastructure protocols to solve compute-intensive and safety-critical problems.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Autonomous Systems & Data Intelligence
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Synthesize data-driven machine learning models, intelligent interfaces, and automated verification pipelines to deliver measurable operational impact.

bloomsLevels.name: Remember
bloomsLevels.description: Retrieve relevant knowledge from long-term memory. Recognizing and recalling relevant facts, terms, and concepts.

bloomsLevels.name: Understand
bloomsLevels.description: Construct meaning from instructional messages, including oral, written, and graphic communication. Interpreting, exemplifying, classifying.

bloomsLevels.name: Apply
bloomsLevels.description: Carry out or use a procedure in a given situation. Executing or implementing computational algorithms and design patterns.

bloomsLevels.name: Analyze
bloomsLevels.description: Break material into constituent parts, determining how parts relate to one another and to an overall structure or purpose.

bloomsLevels.name: Evaluate
bloomsLevels.description: Make judgments based on criteria and standards. Checking, verifying, critiquing algorithmic performance and security compliance.

bloomsLevels.name: Create
bloomsLevels.description: Put elements together to form a coherent or functional whole; reorganize elements into a new pattern or structure.
